Cc: ClearBridge Ops <ops@clearbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for full incident dossier and verification steps

Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick responses during the service interruption on 2028-10-25. Our compliance team is preparing a vendor evidence packet for our auditors and has asked for a consolidated incident dossier that includes:

- An annotated timeline (UTC preferred) of events and state changes
- The root cause summary with technical details at a level suitable for our engineering reviewers
- Actions taken to remediate and the owners/ETAs for outstanding items
- A list of the artifacts you can provide (logs, config snapshots, runbooks, signed attestations) and the retention window

We'd also like to schedule a short verification call next week to walk through the runbook steps you used to mitigate the impact. Ideally the verification would include a checklist we can mark as 'verified' once our ops team confirms the reproduction steps.

Can you send the dossier and proposed verification runbook by EOD Monday (2028-10-30)? If there are any items that cannot be shared due to security, please flag them and provide the reason.

Appreciate it — we need the packet for our 11/02 audit intake.

Best,
Olivia Park
Director, Infrastructure Compliance
ClearBridge Financial

Attachment: request-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@clearbridge.com>, ClearBridge Ops <ops@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full incident dossier and verification steps

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a consolidated incident dossier and a verification runbook we prepared specifically for ClearBridge. High level summary up front:

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2028-10-25T14:07:00Z — 2028-10-25T14:43:00Z (token service degradation impacting inference requests for tenant cb-prod-17).
- Root cause: a regression in the KV-cache eviction heuristic combined with an edge autoscaling race that allowed a small set of nodes to accept requests while backend cache lookups returned stale pointers; this produced elevated tokenization latencies and transient 5xxs for affected sessions.
- Immediate mitigation: we rolled back the eviction heuristic change, forced a rolling restart of the affected pool, and applied a hotfix to the autoscaler to prevent the race. Latency and error rates returned to baseline within ~36 minutes of the fix.

What we are delivering (attachments):
- redwood_incident_dossier-20281028.pdf — annotated timeline (UTC), event graphs, and a technical RCA section with repro steps sanitized for customer sharing.
- verification-runbook-v1.md — a step-by-step verification checklist your ops team can run (includes commands, expected responses, and safe flags to replicate the mitigation).
- evidence-harvest-summary.zip — a curated set of logs, config snapshots, and request traces for the cb-prod-17 tenant (we redacted PII and secrets).

Notes on sharing and constraints:
- We redacted internal orchestration IDs and host-level credentials. Host-level artifacts can be made available under an NDA and by shared audit session if required.
- Retention: logs provided are a 90-day export; if you need a longer window we can coordinate an extended export (may take 48–72 hours).

Action items and owners (initial):
- Monica Patel (Customer Success): coordinate evidence handoff and confirm artifacts are consumable by your audit tools — ETA 2028-10-30 EOD.
- Hannah Schmitt (SRE): deliver a signed mitigation attestation and provide a short note on the autoscaler patch — ETA 2028-10-31 midday.
- Marcus Lin (Director, Customer Reliability): schedule verification call + deliver runbook and dossier — scheduling link below.

Proposed verification slots: Tue 10/31 10:00–10:30 PT, Tue 10/31 15:00–15:30 PT, Wed 11/01 09:00–09:30 PT. Please pick one and we will send a calendar invite.

Related links:
- Dossier (PDF): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-incident-dossier
- Support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2237

Attachments:
- redwood_incident_dossier-20281028.pdf (PDF, 1.8 MB)
- verification-runbook-v1.md (text, 45 KB)
- evidence-harvest-summary.zip (zip, 12.3 MB)

If you prefer, we can redact additional fields prior to sharing — let Monica and I know. I'll follow up after Monica confirms the artifact formats.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Reliability Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0149

Following up with two clarifications for the verification workflow:

1) Evidence format: the evidence zip contains a small index.csv that maps trace IDs to time windows and redaction status. If ClearBridge needs the raw traces (no redaction), we require a Data Sharing Agreement addendum; we can prepare draft language and fast-track it.

2) Verification checklist: the runbook contains a lightweight simulated verification that your ops team can run against a staging tenant without elevating privileges. We included both the ‘safe’ path (recommended) and a verification-for-audit path that requires a privileged session. If you want the privileged checklist, we will coordinate a supervised session with our SREs.

I'll own the artifact handoff and will upload the raw index and a small README to the Drive link Marcus included. Monica (cc).

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
